title: Clean-separation derivation and circularity grammar
scope: Test whether Step-38 clean separation follows from a standard confining-sector requirement, and audit implication, relaxation, and circularity.
audit: run_step39.py validates Step-35 survivor reproduction, standardness counts, implication tests, circularity reporting, relaxation robustness, source paths, and no-overclaim boundaries.
note: The condition is load-bearing and neutral in the finite carrier, but it is extensionally equivalent to clean separation and therefore lacks a more basic independent basis here.
non_triviality_argument: The grammar is nontrivial because relaxing the vector exclusion restores all 12 survivors; it is self-critical because it reports equivalence rather than overclaiming derivation.
excluded_designs_rationale: Excluded designs: fixed route-count requirements, slot-count locks, larger-group recognition priors, empirical content insertion, target-shape primitives, size orderings, and hidden circularity.
constraint_transfer: Gshadow to Gstandardness: test derivation of clean separation from confining-sector standardness; result keeps Step-38 qualified because the implication is circular on this carrier.
